column1: # EVIDENCE-effort-intermediate-0820.tsv — THE FROZEN EFFORT INTERMEDIATE
# Owner: the EVIDENCE seat. Charter: docs/measurement-preregistration.md §1-2
# (frozen 2026-08-06, Council I). Written 2026-09-11.
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS, IN ONE SENTENCE
# The effort figures this campaign publishes were measured over session
# transcripts that the client DELETES on a rolling retention schedule, and
# 2.4 days of the campaign window are already gone from disk -- so this file
# is the surviving record of a measurement whose source no longer exists.
# ⛔⛔ THE COLLECTION STEP IS NOT RE-RUNNABLE, AND THE REASON CHANGED.
#   It was believed (2026-08-20) to be non-re-runnable because the committed
#   tool's seat-root glob was a scrubbed placeholder. THAT WAS REPAIRED IN
#   PUBLIC on 2026-08-23 (ledger_common.py, commit f782ded) and the shipped
#   code now discovers every root. The figure still does not re-derive -- for
#   a different and permanent reason: THE TRANSCRIPTS THEMSELVES ARE GONE.
#   ⇒ A STALE CAUSE SURVIVES A CORRECT VERDICT, AND IT IS THE CAUSE THAT
#     TELLS THE NEXT READER WHETHER TO REACH FOR A REPAIR.
# ✅ THE HEADLINE IS NEVERTHELESS CORROBORATED TO 0.01%, FROM TWO PIECES,
#   ONE OF WHICH WAS ALREADY PUBLIC BEFORE ITS SUBSTRATE PERISHED:
#     piece A  2026-08-05 22:02 -> 2026-08-10 18:40   docs/EVIDENCE-ledger-latest.md
#              (generated 2026-08-10 18:40, committed eeec61b -- a snapshot taken
#              while the data still existed; this is the only witness for the
#              campaign's first five days, which are the three highest-commit days)
#              FROZEN HERE, because it perishes on the same schedule
#     A + B = 84,177 requests / 66,176,286 output  vs the headline 84,171 /
# ⚠️ THE RESIDUAL IS A SEAM ARTEFACT, AND IT WAS CONTROLLED RATHER THAN
#   ASSUMED. Moving the A|B boundary one minute either way walks the residual
#   monotonically through zero:
#     boundary 18:39  ->  +16 req / +19,237 out
#     boundary 18:40  ->   +6 req /  +6,318 out     (the rows below)
#     boundary 18:41  ->   -9 req /  -8,708 out
#   ⇒ the headline is BRACKETED by [84,162 , 84,187] requests, a 25-request
#     window 0.03% wide, and 84,171 lies inside it. The overlap is the ~15
#     requests/minute this campaign was running at that hour, counted twice.
# ⛔ WHAT A RE-RUN RETURNS TODAY, so nobody reads a shortfall as an overclaim:
#   the same tool, same declared window, 2026-09-11 -> 64,099 requests and
#   52,566,927 output: 76.2% and 79.4% of the published figures, beginning
#   2026-08-08 08:30 against a window that opens 2026-08-05 22:00.
#   ⛔ AND THE LOSS IS CONFINED TO ONE HOME, WHICH MY FIRST CENSUS DID NOT SAY.
#     An mtime census reported "no transcript anywhere is older than 2026-08-08"
#     -- true, and it invites the reading that every home lost history. Measured
#     again by DIRECTORY BIRTH TIME: eight of the nine homes were CREATED on or
#     after 2026-08-08 (four at 08-08 08:18, when per-seat isolation split them
#     out of the shared home; the rest later), so their floors are BIRTH DATES
#     and they lost NOTHING. Only the original shared home, born 2026-04-02, has
#     a floor later than its birth -- and everything missing from the window is
#     ⇒ 🔑 A FLOOR IS NOT A DELETION UNTIL YOU KNOW WHEN THE FLOOR WAS BUILT.
#       The shortfall figures above are unchanged; what changes is what a reader
#       should conclude from them about everything else.
#   ✅ POSITIVE CONTROL, AND IT IS WHAT MAKES THE DIAGNOSIS SOUND: the `jas`
#     row re-derives EXACTLY -- 1,862 requests / 345,394 output, to the token --
#     because that seat's transcripts were all written on 2026-08-20 and none
#     has yet aged out. ONE ARM UNCHANGED PROVES THE INSTRUMENT; THE OTHERS
#     MOVING PROVES THE SUBJECT. The tool is not broken; the data is gone.
# FENCES (docs/measurement-preregistration.md §1, and they travel with the numbers)
#   · Unit is TOKENS. The records carry NO account, organisation or subscription
#     identifier, so NO DOLLAR FIGURE AND NO PER-ACCOUNT SPLIT IS DERIVABLE.
#   · CACHE IS ALWAYS ITS OWN COLUMN and never enters a headline.
#   · Requests are DEDUPLICATED BY requestId: one API response is written as
#     several assistant records each repeating the whole usage block; naive
#     summation inflates ~3x (118,225 duplicate records dropped in piece B).
#   · Subagent transcripts are INCLUDED.
#   · Human engaged time is published as a FLOOR: reading and thinking before a
#     block's first message leave no transcript trace.
# ⛔ ROOT COUNT ONLY, AND THE OMISSION IS DELIBERATE. The measurement read 9
#   personal-lane project directories across the fleet's per-seat config homes.
#   The COUNT is published; the ROOT NAMES ARE NOT, because a per-root row names
#   a seat home, and this repo is public. The publishable grain is the PROJECT,
#   and the project decomposition below reconstitutes the headline exactly --
#   so nothing a reviewer needs is withheld. (Narrowing of the helm's ruling of
